overview.commentary: The portfolio returned 60.13% annualised against 23.84% volatility (Sharpe 1.91) — excellent risk-adjusted performance at a moderate risk level. BAC carries the largest weight at 35.0%; AMD dominates risk contribution at 34.6%. On a typical bad day expect losses near 2.34% (95% VaR), with the worst 5% averaging 3.06% (CVaR) and peak-to-trough drawdown over the period of -11.74%. Action: profile looks balanced; monitor correlation drift around the next earnings cycle.

risk.commentary: Monte Carlo (10k paths, 1Y horizon): 95% VaR 5.65%, 99% VaR 20.31%, CVaR 95% 14.92%. Probability of >20% loss: 1.04%. Worst historical replay is GFC_peak_to_trough (-72.26% return, max drawdown -74.86%, worst day -19.65%). GARCH(1,1) 30-day forecast vol is 24.99% vs realised 25.58% — vol regime falling. Persistence alarm: WFC have α+β > 0.95, meaning shocks decay slowly — drawdowns there will compound longer than a Gaussian model would imply.
